# Welcome

This website collects my review articles on probabilistic models, uncertainty quantification, and explainability.

Each paper has its own dedicated review page, and this index groups the papers by the main ideas shaping the review.

Some entries are already fully reviewed, while others are placeholder pages marked **Review in progress** so I can keep track of papers I still want to summarize.

> **Note**
>
> The citation counts below are manual placeholders so I can update them over time.
> The **Published** column is also manual for now. Where I have not yet verified the exact publication month, I use a month-year placeholder format such as `Jan 2025`.

## Conceptual bridge for deterministic readers

This note synthesizes the papers that are most useful for explaining uncertainty taxonomy, uncertainty language, probability, confidence, calibration, and prediction intervals to readers who are more familiar with deterministic models.

| Published | Citations | Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jun 2026 | - | [Uncertainty taxonomy and language for deterministic readers](<reviews/Uncertainty taxonomy and language for deterministic readers.qmd>) | Reusable conceptual bridge for defining aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty, probability vs confidence, prediction intervals vs confidence intervals, calibration, sharpness, consistency, adaptivity, and uncertainty-focused explainability. |

## Explaining prediction intervals and quantiles with SHAP

These papers support the move from explaining only the point forecast to explaining the **distribution, interval width, and risk profile** itself. I need to beat these papers as they are my closest competitors.

| Published | Citations | Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| May 2025 | 7 | [Uncertainty-aware optimization of zeolite particle size: Utilizing quantile regression and SHAP analysis](<reviews/Uncertainty-aware optimization of zeolite particle size.qmd>) | Direct precedent for comparing SHAP contributions across upper and lower bounds to study interval fluctuations. |
| Apr 2024 | 54 | [Quantifying and explaining machine learning uncertainty in predictive process monitoring: an operations research perspective](<reviews/Quantifying and explaining machine learning uncertainty in predictive process monitoring.qmd>) | Uses quantile methods and SHAP specifically to identify the drivers of predictive uncertainty. |
| Aug 2025 | 30 | [Interpretable building energy performance prediction using XGBoost Quantile Regression](<reviews/Interpretable building energy performance prediction using XGBoost Quantile Regression.qmd>) | Shows that feature importance changes across different quantiles, supporting distribution-aware interpretation. |
| Mar 2022 | 181 | [An interpretable probabilistic model for short-term solar power forecasting using natural gradient boosting](<reviews/An interpretable probabilistic model for short-term solar power forecasting using natural gradient boosting.qmd>) | Important domain example explaining both point forecasts and prediction intervals, with a useful contrast to non-parametric approaches. |
| Jan 2025 | 0 | [Explaining Set-Valued Predictions: SHAP Analysis for Conformal Classification](<reviews/Explaining Set-Valued Predictions.qmd>) | Extends SHAP toward explaining set-valued predictions rather than only single-label outputs. |
| Dec 2023 | 76 | [Explaining Predictive Uncertainty with Information Theoretic Shapley Values](<reviews/Explaining Predictive Uncertainty with Information Theoretic Shapley Values.qmd>) | Foundational theoretical basis for adapting Shapley values to predictive uncertainty. |
| Jan 2024 | 53 | [Forecasting Value-at-Risk Using Deep Neural Network Quantile Regression](<reviews/Forecasting Value-at-Risk Using Deep Neural Network Quantile Regression.qmd>) | Supports the combination of deep neural networks, quantile regression, and SHAP. |

## Decomposing aleatoric vs. epistemic uncertainty with XAI

These papers motivate the stronger claim that uncertainty should not only be estimated, but also **split into model ignorance vs. irreducible system variability**.

| Published | Citations | Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| Feb 2026 | 2 | [UbiQTree: Uncertainty quantification in XAI with tree ensembles](<reviews/UbiQTree uncertainty quantification in XAI with tree ensembles.qmd>) | Most direct methodological support for separating SHAP uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components. |
| Jan 2026 | 0 | [Bayesian deep learning for probabilistic aquifer vulnerability and uncertainty prediction](<reviews/Bayesian deep learning for probabilistic aquifer vulnerability and uncertainty prediction.qmd>) | Uses Bayesian deep learning and uncertainty decomposition to distinguish environmental variability from model limitations. |
| Feb 2026 | 1 | [Enhancing energy prediction in variable refrigerant flow cooling systems: A hybrid grey-box model integrating thermodynamic knowledge, experimental data and machine learning](<reviews/Enhancing energy prediction in variable refrigerant flow cooling systems.qmd>) | Energy-systems example explicitly reducing and interpreting both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. |
| Jan 2025 | 6 | [Uncertainty-aware Bayesian neural network with SHAP interpretability for data-driven assembly quality prediction in complex manufacturing systems](<reviews/Uncertainty-aware Bayesian neural network with SHAP interpretability.qmd>) | Connects uncertainty bounds directly to feature contributions using a Bayesian neural model with SHAP. |
| Jul 2024 | 4 | [Uncertainty-Aware and Explainable Human Error Detection in the Operation of Nuclear Power Plants](<reviews/Uncertainty-Aware and Explainable Human Error Detection in the Operation of Nuclear Power Plants.qmd>) | Strong support for trust, operator interaction, and explaining both prediction accuracy and uncertainty in safety-critical settings. |
| Oct 2025 | 0 | [A Unified Framework for Interpretable and Uncertainty-Aware Battery State of Health Estimation Using Deep Neural Networks](<reviews/A Unified Framework for Interpretable and Uncertainty-Aware Battery State of Health Estimation.qmd>) | Combines SHAP with intervals that explicitly capture both epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty in an energy application. |

## Status quo baseline: deep learning + intervals/quantiles + SHAP in power systems

These papers define the immediate baseline: strong probabilistic forecasting systems that still often explain the **forecast** more clearly than the **uncertainty width itself**.

| Published | Citations | Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jan 2025 | 23 | [Explainable deeply-fused nets electricity demand prediction model: Factoring climate predictors for accuracy and deeper insights with probabilistic confidence interval and point-based forecasts](<reviews/Explainable deeply-fused nets electricity demand prediction model.qmd>) | A close baseline: combines deep learning, intervals, and SHAP, but focuses interpretability more on the point forecast than on interval width. |
| Jul 2023 | 19 | [Day-Ahead Electricity Price Probabilistic Forecasting Based on SHAP Feature Selection and LSTNet Quantile Regression](<reviews/Day-Ahead Electricity Price Probabilistic Forecasting Based on SHAP Feature Selection and LSTNet Quantile Regression.qmd>) | Uses SHAP mainly for feature selection before forecasting rather than for explaining uncertainty dynamically after prediction. |
| Jan 2026 | 0 | [Multiscale Wind Forecasting Using Explainable-Adaptive Hybrid Deep Learning](<reviews/Multiscale Wind Forecasting Using Explainable-Adaptive Hybrid Deep Learning.qmd>) | Relevant example of deep learning with adaptive prediction bands and SHAP-based meteorological interpretation. |
| May 2024 | 26 | [Interpretable Interval Prediction-Based Outlier-Adaptive Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting Involving Cross-Market Features](<reviews/Interpretable Interval Prediction-Based Outlier-Adaptive Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting.qmd>) | Interval prediction in electricity markets with interpretability for exogenous drivers. |
| Nov 2025 | 0 | [An Interpretable Hybrid System Using Temporal Convolutional Network and Informer Model for Carbon Price Prediction](<reviews/An Interpretable Hybrid System Using Temporal Convolutional Network and Informer Model for Carbon Price Prediction.qmd>) | Uses deep forecasting, interval estimation, and SHAP in a market-oriented energy setting. |
| Apr 2023 | 15 | [High-resolution probabilistic load forecasting: A learning ensemble approach](<reviews/High-resolution probabilistic load forecasting.qmd>) | Probabilistic load forecasting using a learning ensemble and Shapley-style contribution analysis. |
| Jan 2023 | 27 | [Data-driven cooperative trading framework for a risk-constrained wind integrated power system considering market uncertainties](<reviews/Data-driven cooperative trading framework for a risk-constrained wind integrated power system.qmd>) | Applies quantile-style uncertainty modeling and Shapley analysis in wind-integrated power system decision-making. |

## Critical papers on uncertainty quantification in deep learning

These papers help frame the broader methodological caution: uncertainty estimates can look convincing while still being poorly calibrated, brittle under shift, or conceptually ambiguous.

### Evaluation, robustness, and dataset shift

| Published | Citations | Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jun 2019 | 2607 | [Can You Trust Your Model’s Uncertainty? Evaluating Predictive Uncertainty Under Dataset Shift](<reviews/Can You Trust Your Model’s Uncertainty Evaluating Predictive Uncertainty Under Dataset Shift.qmd>) | Foundational evidence that many uncertainty methods degrade badly under dataset shift. |
| Jan 2019 | 554 | [Failing Loudly: An Empirical Study of Methods for Detecting Dataset Shift](<reviews/Failing Loudly An Empirical Study of Methods for Detecting Dataset Shift.qmd>) | Relevant when connecting predictive uncertainty to reliability monitoring. |
| May 2024 | 57 | [How to Evaluate Uncertainty Estimates in Machine Learning for Regression](<reviews/How to Evaluate Uncertainty Estimates in Machine Learning for Regression.qmd>) | Important for judging whether interval estimates are genuinely informative rather than superficially calibrated. |
| Jan 2022 | 4 | [Validation of uncertainty quantification metrics: a primer based on the consistency and adaptivity concepts](<reviews/Validation of uncertainty quantification metrics a primer based on the consistency and adaptivity concepts.qmd>) | Helps anchor discussions of metric validity and uncertainty-quality assessment. |
| Sep 2021 | 102 | [Preventing dataset shift from breaking machine-learning biomarkers](<reviews/Preventing dataset shift from breaking machine-learning biomarkers.qmd>) | Useful supporting reference on robustness and the practical consequences of shift. |

### Surveys and broader framing

| Published | Citations | Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jan 2023 | 153 | [A Survey on Uncertainty Quantification for Deep Learning: An Uncertainty Source’s Perspective](<reviews/A Survey on Uncertainty Quantification for Deep Learning An Uncertainty Source’s Perspective.qmd>) | Broad survey for positioning the deep-learning UQ landscape, strengths, and open problems. |

## Explaining uncertainty and explainability of UQ

These papers sit closest to the conceptual bridge between **uncertainty quantification** and **explainability**.

| Published | Citations | Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dec 2023 | 76 | [Explaining Predictive Uncertainty with Information Theoretic Shapley Values](<reviews/Explaining Predictive Uncertainty with Information Theoretic Shapley Values.qmd>) | Core theoretical paper for uncertainty-focused Shapley explanations. |
| Jan 2024 | 0 | [Explainability through uncertainty: Trustworthy decision-making with neural networks](<reviews/Explainability through uncertainty Trustworthy decision-making with neural networks.qmd>) | Reframes uncertainty estimation itself as an XAI mechanism that supports trust, rejection decisions, and actionable human-in-the-loop decision-making. |
| Jan 2025 | 0 | [Explaining Set-Valued Predictions: SHAP Analysis for Conformal Classification](<reviews/Explaining Set-Valued Predictions.qmd>) | Useful extension from scalar uncertainty to set-valued predictions. |
